summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of a payment notice for its Fixed Rate Series XXIV Notes, USD 480,454,198 principal due 2035, issued March 31, 2025. The third semiannual interest installment, covering March 31 to September 30, 2026, pays USD 19,218,167.92 at an 8.00% annual nominal rate, effective September 30, 2026, via paying agent The Bank of New York Mellon, to holders of record September 29, 2026. No capital is repaid. This is a routine debt-service disclosure, not a special situation; watch for continued coupon payments tied to the Series XXIV indenture.
